lines.en: scene lockers_day
I arrive at school.
lines.zh: 我到了学校。

lines.en: I’m not sure where Reina went.
lines.zh: 我不确定 Reina 去了哪里。

lines.en: My head hurts for some reason, but I shake it off and remove several textbooks from my locker.
lines.zh: 我的头不知为何有点疼，但我甩了甩头，把几样

lines.en: I hope to learn something new today.
lines.zh: 希望今天能学到点新东西。

lines.en: scene black
I learn nothing.
lines.zh: 我什么都没学到。

lines.en: scene club_noon
The rest of the school day passes normally.
lines.zh: 剩下的上课时间正常地过去了。

lines.en: I skipped lunch because I was still full from the candy I had this morning.
lines.zh: 我跳过了午饭，因为早上吃的糖果还让我很饱。

lines.en: My stomach hurts.
lines.zh: 我的胃疼。

lines.en: Is this the payment I receive for thanking for my organs every day?
lines.zh: 这就是我每天感谢器官所得到的回报吗？

lines.en: There really is no god.
lines.zh: 果然没有上帝。

lines.en: : I had a feeling you'd be in here.
lines.zh: : 我就感觉你会在这儿。

lines.en: show saki_normal
: Oh, Saki. What a pleasant surprise.
lines.zh: : 哦，Saki。真是个愉快的惊喜。

lines.en: : I thought you might have been absent since you didn’t drop by this morning.
lines.zh: : 你早上没过来，我还以为你今天缺席了。

lines.en: show saki_worried
: I did drop by...You weren’t there.
lines.zh: : 我确实去过了……可你不在。

lines.en: : Here.
Saki hands me a piece of candy. I shove it into my mouth
lines.zh: Saki 递给我一颗糖果。我把它塞进嘴里。

lines.en: A delicious lunch.
lines.zh: 一份美味的午餐。

lines.en: My stomach suddenly feels better.
lines.zh: 我的胃突然感觉好多了。

lines.en: : Thanks. I can always count on you to provide my daily dose of unrivaled nutritional value.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我总能指望你给我提供每日所需的

lines.en: show saki_angry
: I’m good for more than just 'unrivaled nutritional value' you know...
lines.zh: : 我可不止有「无与伦比的营养价值」这一项用处哦。

lines.en: : I know, I know. You do a lot for me.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。你为我做了很多。

lines.en: : I appreciate it. Really.
lines.zh: : 我很感激。真的。

lines.en: Saki lets out a sigh and takes a seat on a crate near the door.
lines.zh: Saki 叹了口气，在门边的一个木箱上坐下。

lines.en: This is our club room.
lines.zh: 这里是我们的社团室。

lines.en: It’s not very spacious, but it gets the job done.
lines.zh: 不算宽敞，但够用了。

lines.en: Saki doesn’t come much anymore. Probably because of Miu.
lines.zh: Saki 现在不太来了。大概是因为 Miu。

lines.en: The two of them have been fighting for a few months now.
lines.zh: 她们两个已经吵了几个月了。

lines.en: Oh, that’s right. You haven’t met Miu yet.
lines.zh: 哦，对了。你还没见过 Miu。

lines.en: Miu and Reina are the third and fourth members of the “Going Home Eventually” club.
lines.zh: Miu 和 Reina 是「回家部」的第三和第四名成员。

lines.en: We’re just like the “Going Home” club but more delayed.
lines.zh: 我们就像「回家部」，只是更拖沓。

lines.en: Sometimes, we even sleep here if we don’t feel like going home at all.
lines.zh: 有时候，如果不想回家，我们甚至会睡在这儿。

lines.en: On those days, we become the “Not Going Home” club.
lines.zh: 那些日子里，我们就变成了「不回家部」。

lines.en: show saki_worried
: Hey, how are things at your place?
lines.zh: : 喂，你那边最近怎么样？

lines.en: : Is the water back on yet?
lines.zh: : 水恢复供应了吗？

lines.en: : No, not yet. I’m surprised that Josh is still alive.
lines.zh: : 没有，还没。我很惊讶 Josh 居然还活着。

lines.en: Josh is the name of my window-plant. A gift from Saki.
lines.zh: Josh 是我那株窗台植物的名字。Saki 送的礼物。

lines.en: show saki_normal
: Well duh, he’s invincible.
lines.zh: : 那当然，他可是无敌的。

lines.en: : You think I’d give you a plant that was just going to die if you forgot to water it once or twice?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会送你一株没人管就会死的植物吗？

lines.en: : I know better than anyone how forgetful you can be.
lines.zh: : 我比谁都清楚你有多健忘。

lines.en: : You really do, don't you?
lines.zh: : 你还真是清楚啊。

lines.en: : I feel like you probably know even more about my tendencies than I do at this point.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你对我的习性了解得比我自己还多。

lines.en: : Thanks for observing my life with such a meticulous amount of detail.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你这么细致入微地观察我的人生。

lines.en: : That's what I'm here for.
lines.zh: : 这就是我存在的意义。

lines.en: show saki_happy
: Oh, do you need me to stop by and pick up some laundry later?
lines.zh: : 哦，需要我晚点顺路来收些衣服去洗吗？

lines.en: : I’m free this weekend so-
lines.zh: : 我这周末有空，所以 ——

lines.en: : No, I’m okay. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了，我没事。谢谢。

lines.en: : I was actually planning on going to the lake tomorrow, anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我本来就打算明天去湖边。

lines.en: show saki_worried
: Does that mean you won't be coming to school?
lines.zh: : 那是不是说，你不来学校了？

lines.en: : It can’t be helped.
lines.zh: : 那也没办法。

lines.en: show saki_angry
: Yuu…
lines.zh: : Yuu……

lines.en: Saki worries more about my attendance than I do.
lines.zh: Saki 比我自己还操心我的出勤。

lines.en: She’s done her best to fill the shoes of my mother ever since that whole ordeal with the aliens.
lines.zh: 从那天起，她就一直尽力填补我母亲留下的空缺。

lines.en: I wish I could say I’ve done the same for her, but I haven’t.
lines.zh: 我希望能说我也为她做了同样的事，但我没有。

lines.en: Not even close.
lines.zh: 差得远。

lines.en: There’s nothing you can do to comfort someone who went through what she did.
lines.zh: 你无法安慰一个经历过那种事的人。

lines.en: So the best course of action is ignoring it and letting her handle it on her own.
lines.zh: 所以最好的做法就是装作不知道，让她自己去面对。

lines.en: : Will you bring me your notes, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你能把笔记带给我吗？

lines.en: : I want to make sure I do okay on the final exams coming up.
lines.zh: : 我想确保在接下来的期末考试里考得好。

lines.en: show saki_normal
: Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll even bring you dinner as well?
lines.zh: : 说不定我还能顺便给你带晚饭？

lines.en: : Please do.
lines.zh: : 那就拜托了。

lines.en: : Hmm...Does hamburger steak sound okay?
lines.zh: : 嗯……汉堡肉排怎么样？

lines.en: Oh my god.
lines.zh: 天哪。

lines.en: : Saki…
lines.zh: : Saki……

lines.en: show saki_worried
: Hm? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: I get down on one knee in front of her crate.
lines.zh: 我在她的木箱前单膝跪下。

lines.en: : Will you marry me?
lines.zh: : 你愿意嫁给我吗？

lines.en: show saki_surprised
: Wow, you really like hamburger steak.
lines.zh: : 哇，你还真是喜欢汉堡肉排。

lines.en: : I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。

lines.en: I channel my inner-bibliophile and summon one of my favorite quotes from the depths of my infinite wisdom.
lines.zh: 我唤起内心那个爱书人，搬出我最喜欢的一句名言。

lines.en: : {i}“The quickest way to a man’s heart is with a large slab of meat.”{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}「通往男人心房最快的方式，是一大块

lines.en: : William Shakespeare said that.
lines.zh: : 威廉·莎士比亚说过这话。

lines.en: show saki_normal
: I...don’t think he did. But okay.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得他说过。不过好吧。

lines.en: : Is there anything else you need?
lines.zh: : 你还需要别的什么吗？

lines.en: : I have to stop at the store on the way home, so I can pick up some things for you.
lines.zh: : 我回家路上得去一趟店里，所以我可以顺便买。

lines.en: Hmm...I {i}am{/i} running low on pretty much everything, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 嗯……既然这样，我{i}确实{/i}几乎所有东西都快用完了。

lines.en: I can’t even remember the last time I had an actual meal.
lines.zh: 我甚至想不起来上一次吃正经饭是什么时候。

lines.en: My life has become a vicious cycle of plain noodles and convenience store rice balls.
lines.zh: 我的人生已经变成了白面条和便利食品的恶性循环。

lines.en: Things designed to fill your stomach and warm your heart.
lines.zh: 那些东西被设计来填饱你的胃、温暖你的心。

lines.en: Unfortunately, one of the side effects of a warm heart and a full stomach is an unhappy tongue.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，温暖的心和饱腹的胃带来的副作用之一是 ——

lines.en: show saki_curious
: Yuu? You’re zoning out. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : Yuu？你走神了。你还好吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Oh, yeah- sorry. Internal monologue.
lines.zh: : 啊？哦，是啊 —— 抱歉。内心独白。

lines.en: : Right…
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : So, do you need anything or not?
lines.zh: : 所以，你到底需不需要什么？

lines.en: : Or maybe you want me to wait until your monologue is over?
lines.zh: : 还是说你想让我等你的独白讲完？

lines.en: : Yeah, hold on. I'll wrap it up now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，等一下。我现在就收尾。

lines.en: show saki_normal
: Okay…
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: It was at that moment that I decided I could use some things from the store.
lines.zh: 就在那一刻，我决定我确实需要从

lines.en: : Okay. It’s settled.
lines.zh: : 好。就这么定了。

lines.en: : You will purchase me everything printed on this list.
lines.zh: : 你要给我买这张单子上印的所有东西。

lines.en: I remove a shopping list from my back pocket and hand it over to Saki.
lines.zh: 我从后兜里掏出一张购物清单，递给了她。

lines.en: I forgot I was carrying this.
lines.zh: 我都忘了自己身上带着这个。

lines.en: What a convenient turn of events.
lines.zh: 真是方便的发展。

lines.en: show saki_worried
Saki takes a second to look over the grocery list.
lines.zh: Saki 花了一秒扫了一眼那份购物清单。

lines.en: She’s probably thinking of how responsible and mature I am right now.
lines.zh: 她现在大概在想我有多负责任、多成熟。

lines.en: show saki_angry
: This is a receipt for manga…
lines.zh: : 这是买漫画的收据……

lines.en: : What? It is?
lines.zh: : 什么？是吗？

lines.en: : Let me see that.
lines.zh: : 让我看看。

lines.en: Saki hands the crumpled sheet of paper back to me.
lines.zh: Saki 把那张皱巴巴的纸递回给我。

lines.en: She is correct.
lines.zh: 她说得对。

lines.en: It is, indeed, a receipt for manga.
lines.zh: 那确实是一张买漫画的收据。

lines.en: I spent the last of my savings on it a week ago.
lines.zh: 一周前，我把最后的积蓄花在了它上面。

lines.en: I regret nothing.
lines.zh: 我毫不后悔。

lines.en: : Huh. I guess just pick me up the usual then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那还是给我买老样子吧。

lines.en: show saki_normal
: Got it. I figured as much.
lines.zh: : 明白。我就猜是这样。

lines.en: : You should probably try to eat more vegetables, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你大概该试着多吃点蔬菜。

lines.en: : If you keep eating nothing but carbs and junk food, you’re going to turn into a whale.
lines.zh: : 要是你继续只吃碳水和垃圾食品，你迟早会 ——

lines.en: : But you love whales.
lines.zh: : 可你明明喜欢鲸鱼啊。

lines.en: It’s true.
lines.zh: 确实如此。

lines.en: She has a huge stuffed whale that she keeps on her bed.
lines.zh: 她床上放着一只巨大的鲸鱼玩偶。

lines.en: His name is Franklin.
lines.zh: 它叫 Franklin。

lines.en: I won it for her at a festival a few years ago.
lines.zh: 几年前我在一次庙会上替她赢来的。

lines.en: It's the same place where she won me Josh.
lines.zh: 也是她替我赢到 Josh 的同一个地方。

lines.en: As you can see, I am significantly better at festival games than Saki.
lines.zh: 如你所见，我在庙会游戏上比她强得多。

lines.en: Also, a plant is a horrible prize.
lines.zh: 另外，植物作为奖品实在太糟糕了。

lines.en: If you are planning on opening a festival stall, please refrain from stocking it with things like that.
lines.zh: 如果你打算摆庙会摊子，请千万别送

lines.en: : You’re right. I love them very much.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我非常喜欢它们。

lines.en: : But I think I like the human version of Yuu more than I would the oceanic one.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得，比起喜欢鲸鱼，我更喜欢人类版的 Yuu。

lines.en: : There’s only enough room in my life for one whale.
lines.zh: : 我的人生里只容得下一只鲸鱼。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Franklin.
lines.zh: 对不起，Franklin。

lines.en: That whale is going to be me.
lines.zh: 那只鲸鱼要变成我了。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I’ll try to take a little more care of myself.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我会试着多照顾自己一点。

lines.en: I start to think about what would happen to Saki if my malnutrition caught up to me.
lines.zh: 我开始想，如果我的营养不良 ——

lines.en: She’d be the one sitting at my bedside as machines pump vital nutrients and fluids into my body.
lines.zh: 她会是那个坐在我床边的人，机器往我体内泵着必需的营养。

lines.en: Then one day, the machines would fail in the middle of the night and she’d rush out of the room to find a doctor.
lines.zh: 然后某一天，机器会在半夜失效。

lines.en: But by the time she gets back, I’ll have already been dead for forty-seven seconds.
lines.zh: 但等她回来时，我已经死了好几分钟了。

lines.en: Efforts to revive me would fail.
lines.zh: 抢救我的努力会失败。

lines.en: Then, Saki would plunge further into despair and take her own life weeks later.
lines.zh: 然后，Saki 会陷得更深，并结束自己的生命。

lines.en: And so the moral of the story is to always eat your vegetables.
lines.zh: 所以这个故事的寓意是：一定要吃你的蔬菜。

lines.en: show saki_worried
: Another monologue?
lines.zh: : 又是一段独白？

lines.en: : Huh? Yeah. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 啊？是啊。抱歉。

lines.en: show saki_curious
: You’re getting a lot of those today, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 你今天已经发呆好多次了，对吧？

lines.en: : I guess so.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : I keep feeling like I’m being watched.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得有人在看着我。

lines.en: : Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : Is someone stalking you?
lines.zh: : 有人在跟踪你吗？

lines.en: : Who is it?
lines.zh: : 是谁？

lines.en: show saki_angry
: I’ll kill them...
lines.zh: : 我要杀了他们……

lines.en: : Careful, Saki. Your yandere side is coming out.
lines.zh: : 小心点，Saki。你的病娇面露出来了。

lines.en: show saki_happy
: Whoops! Hahahaha!~
lines.zh: : 哎呀！哈哈哈哈哈~

lines.en: Saki isn’t actually a yandere.
lines.zh: Saki 其实并不是病娇。

lines.en: At least I don’t think she is.
lines.zh: 至少我不觉得她是。

lines.en: She’s just afraid of losing me.
lines.zh: 她只是害怕失去我。

lines.en: Afraid of losing the one thing still tying her to her childhood.
lines.zh: 害怕失去那唯一还把她和童年连在一起的东西。

lines.en: Just like I’m afraid of losing free laundry service and the occasional home-cooked meal.
lines.zh: 就像我害怕失去免费的洗衣服务，以及偶尔的 ——

lines.en: show saki_surprised
: Oh, right. I forgot to tell you. I bumped into Reina after fourth period.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。我忘了跟你说。我第四节课后碰见 Reina 了。

lines.en: : She told me to tell you she's sorry.
lines.zh: : 她让我转告你，她很抱歉。

lines.en: show saki_worried
: Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了吗？

lines.en: : With Reina? Not really.
lines.zh: : 和 Reina？没什么。

lines.en: : I saw her on the way to school this morning but that’s pretty much the extent of that meeting.
lines.zh: : 我今早上学的路上见到她了，但那也没什么。

lines.en: : I don’t think there was anything to apologize for…
lines.zh: : 我不觉得有什么需要道歉的……

lines.en: : Unless she’s just apologizing for being weird.
lines.zh: : 除非她只是为自己太奇怪而道歉。

lines.en: : If that's the case, then I accept. Please relay the message.
lines.zh: : 如果是那样，那我接受。请转告她。

lines.en: show saki_normal
: Will do.
show saki_curious
: Do you mind if I leave out the part about her being weird, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，我可以省略掉她「太奇怪」那部分吗？

lines.en: : I don’t want to hurt her feelings.
lines.zh: : 我不想伤她的心。

lines.en: : If you must.
lines.zh: : 随你吧。

lines.en: The two of us talk for another hour or so.
lines.zh: 我们又聊了大约一个小时。

lines.en: Saki fills me in on what’s been happening during my absences.
lines.zh: Saki 给我补上了我缺席期间发生的种种。

lines.en: Every ounce of her story bleeds childish jubilance.
lines.zh: 她讲的每一个字都透着孩子气的欢腾。

lines.en: I can feel myself getting wrapped up in it.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到自己也陷了进去。

lines.en: It’s almost as if I were there- laughing and gossiping alongside my childhood friend.
lines.zh: 简直就像我也在场 —— 和她一起笑着、八卦着。

lines.en: You know, just being a normal high-school student and doing normal high-school stuff.
lines.zh: 就是做个普通高中生，做普通高中生该做的事。

lines.en: Part of me thinks about turning over a new leaf and coming to school more often.
lines.zh: 我有一部分在想，要不要改头换面、来上学。

lines.en: But then I remember how exhausting it is to even get out of bed most days.
lines.zh: 但接着我又想起，光是起床就已经耗尽了我。

lines.en: And now I’m back to not wanting to go at all.
lines.zh: 于是现在，我又完全不想去了。

lines.en: I wish I could make my own school.
lines.zh: 我希望我能办一所自己的学校。

lines.en: One where I could pick the subjects and the teachers.
lines.zh: 一所我能自己挑科目和老师的学校。

lines.en: I’d replace the cafeteria menu with candy and hamburger steak.
lines.zh: 我会把食堂菜单换成糖果和汉堡肉排。

lines.en: Instead of radio calisthenics, we would all thank our organs every morning.
lines.zh: 不做广播体操，我们全体每天感谢自己的器官。

lines.en: Then, when those organs inevitably remain silent, we'd console one another.
lines.zh: 然后，当那些器官不可避免地保持沉默时，我们就互相安慰。

lines.en: And then we would cry as we laugh about the concept of religion and accept that we were put on this earth to make children and then die."
lines.zh: 接着我们会一边笑谈宗教这个概念，一边流泪。

lines.en: Hahahahahahaha.
lines.zh: Hahahahahahaha.

lines.en: Hahahahahahahahahaha.
lines.zh: Hahahahahahahahahaha.

lines.en: Hahahahahahaha.
lines.zh: Hahahahahahaha.

lines.en: Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha.
lines.zh: Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha.

lines.zh: Hahahahahahaha.

lines.en: Hahahahahahahahahahah.
lines.zh: Hahahahahahahahahahah.

lines.en: Hahahahaha.
lines.zh: Hahahahaha.

lines.en: HahahahahahahaHAHAHAHAHAH.
lines.zh: HahahahahahahaHAHAHAHAHAH.

lines.en: HAAAAAAAAAAAHAHHHAaAAAAAAhahAHAHAHAhahaahahAhAHaHH!!!!
lines.zh: HAAAAAAAAAAAHAHHHAaAAAAAAhahAHAHAHAhahaahahAhAHaHH!!!!

lines.en: HHHHHHHHAAAAAAAAAHAHAHAHHHAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHA!!!!!
lines.zh: HHHHHHHHAAAAAAAAAHAHAHAHHHAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHA!!!!!

lines.en: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
lines.zh: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

lines.en: Hahah~
lines.zh: Hahah~

lines.en: scene club_night
Saki is gone.
lines.zh: Saki 走了。

lines.en: Night comes.
lines.zh: 夜晚降临。

lines.en: I go home.
lines.zh: 我回家。

lines.en: scene black
Where is home again?
lines.zh: 家又在哪里？

lines.en: scene lake_night
$ renpy.music.set_volume(0.9, 0.0, channel="music")
I fill the bucket with water from the lake.
lines.zh: 我从湖里把水桶装满水。

lines.en: It's like stealing from God.
lines.zh: 这就像从上帝那里偷东西。

lines.en: This is his water.
lines.zh: 这是他的水。

lines.en: I will turn it to wine.
lines.zh: 我要把它变成酒。

lines.en: : ¿sǝɔɐld ɟo ʇsǝᴉloɥ ǝuᴉɯ ǝlᴉɟǝp noɥʇ ʇsop ʎɥM
lines.zh: : ¿sǝɔɐld ɟo ʇsǝᴉloɥ ǝuᴉɯ ǝlᴉɟǝp noɥʇ ʇsod ʎɥM (你为何要定义我的空间之洞？)

lines.en: : ˙˙˙plᴉɥɔ ɐ ʇnq ʇɹɐ noɥ┴ (┴hou art but a child...)
lines.zh: : ˙˙˙plᴉɥɔ ɐ ʇnq ʇɹɐ noɥ┴ (你不过是个孩子……)

lines.en: : ˙ʇɥƃᴉǝʍ ɥɔns ɹɐǝq pǝǝu ǝuᴉɯ ɟo plᴉɥɔ oN (No child of mine need bear such weight.)
lines.zh: : ˙ʇɥƃᴉǝʍ ɥɔns ɹɐǝq pǝǝu ǝuᴉɯ ɟo plᴉɥɔ oN (我的孩子无需承受如此重负。)

lines.en: : ˙suᴉs ǝuᴉɥʇ ʎɐʍɐ ɥsɐM ˙ǝɯ ǝɹoɟǝq ǝɥʇɐq (bathe before me. Wash away thine sins.)
lines.zh: : ˙suᴉs ǝuᴉɥʇ ʎɐʍɐ ɥsɐM ˙ǝɯ ǝɹoɟǝq ǝɥʇɐq (在我面前沐浴。洗去你的罪。)

lines.en: : ˙ǝɹoɯ ǝɔuo ʎloɥ ǝq ʇlɐɥs noɥ┴ (┴hou shalt be holy once more.)
lines.zh: : ˙ǝɹoɯ ǝɔuo ʎloɥ ǝq ʇlɐɥs noɥ┴ (你将再次变得圣洁。)

lines.en: : I need my clothes washed, not my sins.
lines.zh: : 我需要的是衣服被洗干净，不是我的罪。

lines.en: : But thank you.
lines.zh: : 不过，谢谢你。

lines.en: God disappears.
lines.zh: 上帝消失了。

lines.en: He does that a lot.
lines.zh: 他经常这样。

lines.en: His words are upside down.
lines.zh: 他的话是倒着的。

lines.en: They fall into the water.
lines.zh: 它们落进了水里。

lines.en: *Splash*
lines.zh: *扑通*

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: Nothing falls but me.
lines.zh: 除了我，没有什么会坠落。

lines.en: I go back to filling the bucket.
lines.zh: 我回去继续往桶里装水。

lines.en: My hands are covered in holy water.
lines.zh: 我的双手沾满了圣水。

lines.en: They shake like jackhammers.
lines.zh: 它们抖得像凿岩机。

lines.en: I’m having a hard time preventing the contents from spilling.
lines.zh: 我很难不让桶里的东西洒出来。

lines.en: Oh, I know.
lines.zh: 哦，我知道了。

lines.en: I will soak my body instead.
lines.zh: 那我就浸泡自己的身体。

lines.en: I will wash away the impurities.
lines.zh: 我要洗去那些杂质。

lines.en: I will soak my body and become holy.
lines.zh: 我要浸泡身体，变得圣洁。

lines.en: scene black
scene lake_night
I remove my clothes.
lines.zh: 我脱掉了衣服。

lines.en: : Ahh…
It’s cold.
lines.zh: 很冷。

lines.en: The rocks scattered amongst the seafloor dig into the soles of my feet.
lines.zh: 散落在湖底的石子扎进我的脚底。

lines.en: I feel the flesh begin to separate.
lines.zh: 我感觉到皮肉开始分离。

lines.en: It hurts.
lines.zh: 很疼。

lines.en: I must clean the wounds so they do not become infected.
lines.zh: 我必须清理伤口，以免感染。

lines.en: I return to land.
lines.zh: 我回到了岸上。

lines.en: I begin to pick sand and rocks out of my feet.
lines.zh: 我开始从脚上挑出沙子和石子。

lines.en: It hurts.
lines.zh: 很疼。

lines.en: Blood drips onto the dock.
lines.zh: 血滴在码头上。

lines.en: It hurts.
lines.zh: 很疼。

lines.en: How will I walk home?
lines.zh: 我要怎么走回家？

lines.en: Where is home again?
lines.zh: 家又在哪里？

lines.en: Someone is coming.
lines.zh: 有人来了。

lines.en: It is at times like this that we must pray.
lines.zh: 正是这种时候，我们才必须祈祷。

lines.en: ‘Our Father, who art in heaven-
lines.zh: 「我们在天上的父 ——

lines.en: Hallowed be thy name-
lines.zh: 愿人都尊你的名为圣 ——

lines.en: Thy kingdom come, thy will be done-
lines.zh: 愿你的国降临，愿你的旨意成就 ——

lines.en: On Earth, as it is in [[redacted].
lines.zh: 行在地上，如同行在 [[已编辑]。

lines.en: Amen.’
lines.zh: 阿们。」

lines.en: My legs are frozen.
lines.zh: 我的双腿僵住了。

lines.en: I can’t walk.
lines.zh: 我走不动。

lines.en: The bucket has tipped over.
lines.zh: 水桶打翻了。

lines.en: The wine is gone.
lines.zh: 酒没了。

lines.en: I’ll need to ask for Saki’s help with laundry after all.
lines.zh: 看来我终究还是得请 Saki 帮忙洗衣服。

lines.en: I’m sorry.
lines.zh: 对不起。

lines.en: $ renpy.music.set_volume(1.0, 0.0, channel="music")
: Senpai? Is that you?
lines.zh: : 学长？是你吗？
: ……Miu？

lines.en: show miu_sad
: What are you doing out here this late?
lines.zh: : 这么晚了，你在这里做什么？

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be at home right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在不是应该在家吗？

lines.en: What {i}am{/i} I doing out here this late?
lines.zh: 这么晚了我到底{i}在{/i}这里做什么？

lines.en: I notice the bucket at my side.
lines.zh: 我注意到身边的水桶。

lines.en: I must have been fetching water.
lines.zh: 我一定是来打水的。

lines.en: That’s right.
lines.zh: 对了。

lines.en: I need to do laundry.
lines.zh: 我要洗衣服。

lines.en: : The water is off at my house, so I needed to come collect some.
lines.zh: : 我家停水了，所以得来这边打点水。

lines.en: : I guess I tripped or something…
lines.zh: : 我大概是绊了一下之类的……

lines.en: A harsh pain spreads throughout my left foot.
lines.zh: 一阵剧痛传遍我的左脚。

lines.en: There are several tiny gashes spread across the sole.
lines.zh: 脚底有几道细小的伤口。

lines.en: I wince in pain as I remove a small shard of sea glass.
lines.zh: 我忍着痛，取出一小块海玻璃碎片。

lines.en: show miu_surprised
: Senpai…
lines.zh: : 学长……

lines.en: Miu turns away for a moment.
lines.zh: Miu 转开了一会儿。

lines.en: : Any chance you could put your clothes back on?
lines.zh: : 你能把衣服穿回去吗？

lines.en: : I can’t really help you if you’re looking like that…
lines.zh: : 你这个样子的话，我实在没法帮你……

lines.en: I’m naked...
lines.zh: 我光着身子……

lines.en: Was I bathing out here?
lines.zh: 我刚才是在这里洗澡？

lines.en: I must have been.
lines.zh: 一定是。

lines.en: What other reason would there be for this?
lines.zh: 不然还能有什么理由？

lines.en: : Yeah, sorry.
lines.zh: : 是啊，抱歉。

lines.en: I put my clothes back on.
lines.zh: 我把衣服穿回去。

lines.en: A sock should be enough to stop the bleeding, but walking might still be a little painful.
lines.zh: 一只袜子应该够止血，但走路可能会

lines.en: : You can turn around now.
lines.zh: : 你可以转过来了。

lines.en: show miu_sad
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我没事。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to worry you.
lines.zh: : 我不是故意让你担心的。

lines.en: : You really shouldn’t be bathing in the lake, senpai...
lines.zh: : 你真的不该在湖里洗澡，学长……

lines.en: : That water is super gross.
lines.zh: : 那水超级恶心。

lines.en: : It’s like, a kajillion times worse than normal lake water.
lines.zh: : 比普通的湖水还要糟上好多好多个亿倍。

lines.en: : That’s a myth.
lines.zh: : 那是谣言。

lines.en: : It’s not all that bad.
lines.zh: : 其实没那么糟。

lines.en: : You should come for a swim with me sometime.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候该跟我一起去游个泳。

lines.en: show miu_surprised
: Wait, what do you mean it’s not all that bad?
lines.zh: : 等等，你说「没那么糟」是什么意思？

lines.en: : Wasn’t there a whole thing about bodies being-
lines.zh: : 不是有一整套关于尸体被 ——

lines.en: : All lies. Not a shred of truth to any of it.
lines.zh: : 全是谎话。一点真的都没有。

lines.en: Typical Miu- believing everything she hears.
lines.zh: 典型的 Miu —— 听什么信什么。

lines.en: : That’s just a thing that the third-years from a while back thought up to mess with transfer students.
lines.zh: : 那只是前几届三年级学生瞎传的。

lines.en: Our academy is one of the oldest in Japan. At least as far as I know.
lines.zh: 我们学校是日本最古老的学校之一。至少据我所知是这样。

lines.en: My mother and father met here.
lines.zh: 我母亲和父亲就是在这里认识的。

lines.en: There was actually a period of time where a few other schools merged into it.
lines.zh: 其实有过一段时间，另外几所学校也 ——

lines.en: The town back then was supposedly a hub for exchange students.
lines.zh: 据说当年的这个镇，是交换生的聚集地。

lines.en: That was well before I was born, though.
lines.zh: 不过那都是在我出生很久之前了。

lines.en: It’s back to normal now.
lines.zh: 现在已经恢复正常了。

lines.en: But the third-years (Myself included) still like to mess with newcomers every once in a while.
lines.zh: 但三年级生（包括我在内）还是喜欢捉弄新生。

lines.en: Miu has only lived here since the beginning of the school year, so she qualifies as one of those.
lines.zh: Miu 是这学年开始才搬来这里的。

lines.en: show miu_pout
: What the heck?!
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？！

lines.en: : That’s so mean...
lines.zh: : 太过分了……

lines.en: : What a dumb thing to spread a rumor about.
lines.zh: : 为这种事散播谣言，真蠢。

lines.en: : You mean to tell me I’ve been avoiding this place for almost an entire year because of some stupid lie?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我几乎整年都在躲着这个地方？

lines.en: : Well, you’re here now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 可你现在不就在这儿吗？

lines.en: show miu_surprised
: Well, yeah...But that’s only because I just happened to be in the area and I thought I heard someone.
lines.zh: : 呃，是啊……但那只是因为我刚好在 ——

lines.en: : So you willingly walked down a dark path in the middle of the night {i}because{/i} you heard someone?
lines.zh: : 所以你是自愿在半夜走上一条黑漆漆的小路？

lines.en: : Are you trying to get yourself killed?
lines.zh: : 你是想把自己弄死吗？

lines.en: show miu_catsmile
: Me? Pfft, of course not.
lines.zh: : 我？噗，当然不是。

lines.en: : You must be forgetting how extraordinarily brave I am.
lines.zh: : 你一定是忘了我有多勇敢。

lines.en: A lie.
lines.zh: 谎言。

lines.en: Miu is far from brave.
lines.zh: Miu 一点也不勇敢。

lines.en: In fact, she’s absolutely terrified of everything.
lines.zh: 事实上，她对一切都怕得要命。

lines.en: The first time I met her, she was huddled in the corner of the gymnasium hyperventilating.
lines.zh: 我第一次见到她时，她蜷缩在体育馆的角落里。

lines.en: I touched her shoulder to try and calm her down.
lines.zh: 我碰了碰她的肩膀，想让她平静下来。

lines.en: She threw up instead.
lines.zh: 结果她吐了。

lines.en: I didn’t realize that could happen from a panic attack.
lines.zh: 我不知道惊恐发作还会导致这种事。

lines.en: Her parents came and picked her up shortly after and I didn’t see her again until a month later.
lines.zh: 不久后她父母来接走了她，我就再也没见过她。

lines.en: That’s when she joined the “Going Home Eventually” club.
lines.zh: 她就是那时候加入「最终会回家部」的。

lines.en: : Silly me, how could I forget something like that?
lines.zh: : 我真是糊涂，怎么会忘了那种事呢？

lines.en: : Beats me. But I’ll forgive you just this once, okay?
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道。不过这次就原谅你吧，好吗？

lines.en: : Thank you, dearest kouhai.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，最亲爱的学妹。

lines.en: : Please do your best to grow into a fine, young woman.
lines.zh: : 请努力长成一个出色的年轻女性吧。

lines.en: show miu_pout
: What the heck? Am I not fine enough as-is, senpai?
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？我现在还不够出色吗，学长？

lines.en: : You mean to tell me that I started putting my hair in twintails for nothing?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我开始扎双马尾是因为 ——

lines.en: She did that for for me?
lines.zh: 她是为了我才那样做的？

lines.en: How does she know about my twintail fetish?
lines.zh: 她怎么知道我有双马尾癖？

lines.en: Who betrayed me?
lines.zh: 谁背叛了我？

lines.en: y "Please tell me, Miu...Which other secrets of mine have you somehow
lines.zh: y "请告诉我，Miu……你还偷偷挖出了我哪些秘密

lines.en: sleuthed your way into discovering?"
lines.zh: 一路打探出来的？"

lines.en: show miu_catsmile
: That’s for me to know and you to find out.
lines.zh: : 那得我知道，你自己去发现。

lines.en: If it seems like she’s flirting with me, it’s because she is.
lines.zh: 如果她看起来像是在跟我调情，那是因为她确实在。

lines.en: I’m the only male at school that Miu actually talks to, and I’ve watched enough anime to understand what that means."
lines.zh: 我是学校里唯一一个 Miu 真正会说话的男性，而且我 ——

lines.en: show miu_normal
: Hey, are you doing anything after this?
lines.zh: : 喂，你之后有事吗？

lines.en: : After this?
lines.zh: : 之后？

lines.en: : You do realize it’s the middle of the night, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道现在是半夜吧？

lines.en: show miu_catsmile
: Of course I do.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。

lines.en: : And because of that, I also understand that you must be suuuuuuuuper tired, right?
lines.zh: : 也正因如此，我还明白你现在一定超 ——

lines.en: : ...What’s your plan here, kouhai?
lines.zh: : ……你到底想干什么，学妹？

lines.en: : Plan? I don’t have a plan.
lines.zh: : 想干什么？我没什么打算。

lines.en: : I just thought it might do you some good to take a real bath, rather than one in some filthy lake.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，你好好洗个澡可能会有好处，

lines.en: : Hmm...And if I refuse?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那如果我拒绝呢？

lines.en: : If you refuse, then…
lines.zh: : 如果你拒绝，那就……

lines.en: show miu_normal
: Wait, why would you refuse?
lines.zh: : 等等，你为什么要拒绝？

lines.en: : Do you not like baths or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不喜欢洗澡还是什么？

lines.en: : I love them. I think I’ve made that pretty clear tonight.
lines.zh: : 我很喜欢。我想今晚我已经表达得够清楚了。

lines.en: show miu_surprised
: Well then why don’t you come over?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不干脆过来？

lines.en: : You can take a hot bath and then cool off with some tea.
lines.zh: : 你可以泡个热水澡，然后喝点茶降降温。

lines.en: : My family is gone for the summer, too, so you won't have to worry about feeling awkward or anything.
lines.zh: : 我家人夏天也都不在，所以你不用担心。

lines.en: I don't know if I'd go that far...
lines.zh: 我不知道自己能不能做到那一步……

lines.en: : This all seems a little too good to be true.
lines.zh: : 这一切看起来好得有点不真实。

lines.en: : What’s the catch?
lines.zh: : 有什么条件？

lines.en: : I’ll have you know that I am absolutely terrible when it comes to housework.
lines.zh: : 我告诉你，我在这种事情上糟糕透了。

lines.en: show miu_pout
: Who says there has to be a catch?
lines.zh: : 谁说一定要有条件？

lines.en: : Can’t a girl be nice to her senpai without expecting anything in return?
lines.zh: : 女孩子就不能单纯对学长好，不求回报吗？

lines.en: show miu_catsmile
: Though...having you clean up the place does sound pretty nice~
lines.zh: : 不过……让你帮忙把地方打扫干净，听起来确实不错~

lines.en: What should I do?
lines.zh: 我该怎么办？

lines.en: Go to Miu's house
lines.zh: 去 Miu 家

lines.en: jump miuhouse
Go home
lines.zh: 回家

lines.en: jump yuuhouse
